summary: Learn supplier sustainability assessment, traceability, scorecards, and greenwashing controls. Build practical procurement tools. Enquire today.
lede: Supplier sustainability assurance helps procurement and supply-chain professionals assess supplier risks and verify sustainability evidence. Participants practise segmenting suppliers by risk, checking evidence quality, and mapping traceability across supplier tiers. They also develop scorecards and corrective-action plans to support sourcing decisions and follow up on unresolved findings.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who collect supplier evidence, make sourcing decisions, monitor chain risks, or report sustainability performance across agricultural, manufacturing, and public procurement value chains. Each role can adapt the templates to its own supplier categories, sourcing model, data maturity, and assurance requirements.
audience: NGO and donor supply chain leads
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to procurement, supplier management, supply chain operations, quality assurance, ESG reporting, or exporter compliance. No coding or programming is required. Basic familiarity with supplier records, purchase categories, contracts, audits, or sustainability questionnaires will help you complete the exercises efficiently. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted evidence review, Scope 3 supplier data, and assurance are taught at conceptual and operational application levels, while scorecards, traceability matrices, checklists, dashboards, and roadmaps receive hands-on treatment.
